import asyncio
from datadog_connector.signal_selector import SignalSelector

async def get_signals\(\):
    selector = SignalSelector\(\)
    signals = await selector.fetch_signals\(hours=12, severity=''high''\)
    for i, s in enumerate\(signals[:10], 1\):
        attrs = s.get\(''attributes'', {}\)
        title = attrs.get\(''custom'', {}\).get\(''title''\) or attrs.get\(''message'', ''''\)[:50]
        sig_id = s.get\(''id'', ''N/A''\)
        print\(f''{i}. {title[:50]:<50} | ID: {sig_id}''\)
    return signals

asyncio.run\(get_signals\(\)\)
")
